name: Successful logon
description: An account successfully logged on. Check the Logon Type field to see whether it was interactive, network, remote desktop, etc.

name: Failed logon
description: An account failed to log on. High volume from one account or IP often indicates a brute-force attempt.

name: Account logged off
description: An account's logon session was ended.

name: Logon with explicit credentials
description: A process attempted to log on using explicitly supplied credentials rather than the current session's, e.g. via runas.

name: User account locked out
description: An account was locked out, usually after too many failed logon attempts.

name: Kerberos pre-authentication failed

name: Kernel-Power: unexpected reboot

description: Logged at boot, when the Event Log service starts. A useful marker for system startup time.

name: Event log service stopped
description: Logged during a clean shutdown, when the Event Log service stops.

name: Unexpected shutdown

description: A service failed to start; the event includes the specific error that was returned.

name: Timeout waiting for service

name: Timeout waiting for service response

name: Service hung on starting

name: Service crashed

name: File system corruption detected

name: Application Error
